spike-sessions WU-7: docs, follow-ups, PoC retirement
description: README section 'Observing Claude Code sessions' with usage examples for the three subcommands. docs/follow-ups/sessions.md listing deferred items (web view, sanitization, cross-session aggregation, purging policy, scope-drift inference refinement). Open three follow-up beads linking back to the design. Update STACK.md only if a new dep was unavoidable (none expected). Plan retirement of the PoC at packages/session-observer/: either delete it once 'metaswarm-dashboard sessions audit' covers the PoC's questions, or move it to /experiments. Decide based on whether the audit output is more informative than the PoC's summary. See docs/design-sessions-spike.md §8 (WU-7) and §13 (DoD).

title: spike-sessions WU-6: CLI subcommands (timeline / audit / tail)
description: packages/sessions/src/cli/{timeline,audit,tail}.ts + new dispatch arm in bin/metaswarm-dashboard for the 'sessions' verb (same pattern as 'collect' and 'config init'). Subcommands: 'timeline <project>' (latest JSONL → flat table; flags --session, --limit, --json); 'audit <project>' (rubric table with OVERALL; flags --session, --json, --persist); 'tail <project>' (1s poll, --interval, --from-start). Respect METASWARM_DASHBOARD_DATA_DIR, METASWARM_DASHBOARD_CONFIG, and a NEW env var CLAUDE_PROJECTS_DIR (default ~/.claude/projects) for fixture-driven tests. Tests via execa against the built CLI on the synthetic fixture; tail test uses a temp JSONL appended-to mid-test. See docs/design-sessions-spike.md §6.

title: spike-sessions WU-5: snapshot writer
description: packages/sessions/src/writer.ts exports writeSessionSnapshot(snapshot, dataDir, fs?). Atomic write, idempotent (overwrites on re-run). Path layout: <dataDir>/projects/<name>/sessions/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<sessionId>.json. Reuse atomicWriteJson from packages/collector/src/writer if exported; else lift to a shared util in packages/types (preferred over duplication). Tests: idempotency, path layout, fs error propagation. See docs/design-sessions-spike.md §4.4 (SessionSnapshot) and §8 (WU-5).

title: spike-sessions WU-4: rubric scorers (10) + composer
description: Ten pure scorers in packages/sessions/src/rubric/*.ts (one file per criterion: setup-discipline, planning, tdd, scope-drift, error-handling, thrashing, cross-reference, communication, prompt-coherence, workflow-touchpoints). Each exports (timeline) → RubricItem. src/rubric/index.ts exports scoreTimeline(timeline) → ProcessRubricScore with aggregate rule (fail > watch > pass; na excluded; all-na → na). Unit tests for each scorer covering pass/watch/fail/na branches. See docs/design-sessions-spike.md §5 (verdict rules per criterion) and §5.1 (aggregate).

title: spike-sessions WU-3: JSONL parser
description: Implement packages/sessions/src/jsonl-reader.ts exporting parseTranscript(filePath, fs?) → SessionTimeline. Pure function, fs injectable. Skip malformed lines gracefully and count them. Map raw JSONL entries to the 7 ToolUseEvent.kind values. Tool-use summaries follow the Python PoC intent (Bash → first 120 chars of command; Read/Write/Edit → file path with repo prefix stripped; Agent → subagent_type: description[:80]; etc.) — see docs/design-sessions-spike.md §12. Tests: synthetic fixture under __tests__/fixtures/ exercising every kind + edges (empty file, single line, mixed valid/invalid). Parity-with-PoC test asserts timeline matches a checked-in expected JSON. See docs/design-sessions-spike.md §4.1-4.2 and §7.

title: spike-sessions WU-2: Zod schemas in @metaswarm-dashboard/types
description: Add packages/types/src/sessions.ts with: ToolUseEvent, SessionTimeline, RubricItem (incl. RubricVerdict enum), ProcessRubricScore (length 10), SessionSnapshot. Re-export from packages/types/src/index.ts. Additive only — do NOT modify snapshots.ts / paths.ts / api.ts. Tests: round-trip safeParse for each schema + length(10) constraint for ProcessRubricScore.items. See docs/design-sessions-spike.md §4.

title: spike-sessions WU-1: workspace skeleton
description: Create packages/sessions/ workspace package: package.json (name @metaswarm-dashboard/sessions, type module, build/typecheck/test scripts mirroring collector), tsconfig.json + tsconfig.build.json, vitest.config.ts, empty src/index.ts. Root package.json workspaces is already packages/* glob — should pick up automatically. DoD: npm install + npm run build + npm run typecheck green on the new package; nothing else broken. See docs/design-sessions-spike.md §3 (module layout) and §8 (WU-1).
